title: Protective Security Officer (PSO) Services throughout Utah and Wyoming
agency_path: HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF.OFFICE OF PROCUREMENT OPERATIONS.FPS WEST CCG
detail_text: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Office of Procurement Operations (OPO), Federal Protective Service (FPS), Acquisitions Division (AD) intends to extend the ordering period of task order 70RFPW25FRW800006 for up to three (3) months, with Diversified Protection Corporation (109 Rier Landing DR, STE 300, Daniel Island, SC 29492), for Armed Protective Security Officer (PSO) services throughout Utah and Wyoming on a basis other than full and open competition. This proposed extension is to provide for continued protective security officer services in the Utah and Wyoming area to allow time to award and transition the follow-on effort for these services. This is not a request for competitive proposals. A Request for Proposal (RFP) will not be made available.
